items.says: A machine with /boot on its root's device brings /boot to rest, by EXT4_IOC_CHECKPOINT or freezing the root, before recording its pointer; until then its update is refused daily with the pointer unrecorded, the one exception model/protocol/update.tla's Converges names, RFC w0w82

`table inet filter` is declared by the machine's module in place of NixOS's firewall, with its zones checked by reverse path, `fib saddr . iif oif missing drop`, and a default drop on the public interface, so nothing comes in from the public network, SSH included; system/base/network.nix still enables NixOS's own firewall

The filter's activation is tried then kept: it is started by the rules' text changing and never by a store path, a failed apply never cancels the previous rollback's timer, nothing becomes the boot default before it is confirmed, and a failed rollback is reported as a failure

Three points of the filter are settled into rules as it is built: whether Tailscale keeps writing its own rules beside the table or the table holds the one it needs, whether the bridge plugin's masquerade stays the plugin's or moves into the table, and how a deployment's `network` is written as addresses and ports

A machine option with the values `global` and `china` sets the substituters, `china` taking a mainland mirror first, then the NixOS cache, then the bucket, and `global` the NixOS cache then the bucket, with require-sigs on, so ivy and dusk drop their hand-written mirror; machine.region in system/options.nix selects nothing today

The address discovery is a Rust crate under system/network/addresses/, reading interface addresses over netlink, the trace over an HTTP client bound to each family and names through a resolver crate, and discover.sh, parse.jq and tests.sh go once it has taken a pointer on okra, sora and oak; it waits on the author choosing Tailscale's netcheck, its LocalAPI or a STUN client

holds.owes: the author's choice among netcheck, LocalAPI and STUN

items.says: The seed's render and boot are a Rust crate and their shell under system/base/seed/ is removed

holds.owes: the crate, and the shell removed

items.says: A machine booted by extlinux writes its new boot files and syncs them before the boot default changes, by a patched extlinux builder in the machine's module, so a power cut inside the switch boots the old generation or the new one whole; model/protocol/powercut.tla's DEFAULT_BEFORE_REST is the order it closes

holds.owes: the patched builder and a test that its default moves only after the files are synced
